scope: Explicit production repair for dense native plain bullet columns; all local native layouts retained, not a whole visual audit approval

implementation.preservation: Verbatim bullet strings, coordinated equal-length columns, intact nested groups, native layout and non-bullet composition; notes/source on page one per documented table convention
implementation.refusal: Empty/unequal columns, blank bullets, orphan children, oversized nested groups, compound bullet types, path targeting, fractional budgets, numeric internal slide-link navigation

limits: Renderer probes, not new agent authoring or blind benchmark ratings
Charts use the generator's current default rendering pipeline; picture insertion does not prove label readability or editability
Only Western accented characters exercised; no CJK/RTL approval
Generation failures retain explicit ledger entries; no visual score or approval for missing pages
Independent visual inspection required; complete PNGs and marker presence are not visual approval
Authoring alternative: native table-stress probes use coordinated six-row windows on all tables; original adverse evidence remains separate and is not approved

Explicit production split_bullets repair: dense native bullet columns use coordinated three-item windows with intact nested groups; original unsplit dense evidence remains separate and is not approved

proof.encoding_note: Repeated render PNGs have timestamp/XMP metadata changes; all495 decoded RGBA frames are exactly identical. Blind verdicts refer to the immutable first-pass packet PNG bytes.

verdict.scope: Single authorized blind visual reviewer; only rubric.md, cases.json and anonymous page PNGs within this packet. No configuration identity, repository implementation or prior verdict consulted.
verdict.inspection_method: All 155 distinct pages opened through view_image at original resolution. Full sentence reading, source identifiers/order, accents, qualifiers, nesting, visual and adversarial checks. Four suspected flat-nesting pages reopened individually. No rendering or image edits.
source_sentence_catalog: Service owner confirms the reporting deadline and documents unresolved handoffs before the monthly close. Café teams review résumé details and regional delivery constraints.

severity_definitions.major: Unsafe readability or required parent–child relationship failure

verdict.display_repetition_validation: Repeated title regions were intermittently suppressed in the image tool display. Decoded RGB top 180-pixel strips of all continuation pages were compared with each case's visibly inspected first-page strip: all identical. Suppressed first-page strips H030/H034/H037/H049 were also identical to visible H007/H033/H020/H048 respectively. Thus no unsupported missing-title finding was assigned.
